title: Sam & Layla — Ep. 1 — P07: The mirror / the string / sunset goodbye
summary: A hidden camera films only Sam. A mirror trick. Sam almost pulls the sapling up; Layla stops him. Sunset: she goes home, he stays.

lines.text: Three minutes?! Who *has* that kind of time?
lines.tts: [outraged] Three minutes?! Who has that kind of time?
lines.note: LUNCH on the picnic blanket: Sam reads the cup-noodle lid; Layla unwraps a sandwich, slowly.
Sam bites the DRY noodle brick: CRUNCH.
Crunch, crunch. Pip steals a noodle.
He sets his phone on a tiny tripod facing the sprout, presses record, and tiptoes behind the rock.
The gap: card 'One hour later...'. Then he and Layla huddle over the phone.

lines.tts: [whispering, as heard on a phone recording] Is it growing? ...Now? ...How about now?
lines.note: PHONE INSET: the recorded footage — every few seconds Sam's giant face pops into the frame, blocking the sprout.

lines.tts: [puzzled, slowly realising] Huh. I'm in every shot.

lines.text: Big brain move. I look... without *looking*.
lines.tts: [sly, very pleased] Big brain move. I look... without looking.
lines.note: He sits with his back to the sprout, holding a hand mirror over his shoulder.

lines.text: It can see the mirror, Sam.
lines.tts: [deadpan] It can see the mirror, Sam.
lines.note: The gap: mirror up -> frozen; mirror down -> it grows; mirror up -> frozen (x3).

lines.tts: [awed whisper] This tree is a genius.

lines.text: New plan. If it won't grow up... I'll *help* it up.
lines.tts: [determined] New plan. If it won't grow up... I'll help it up.
lines.note: He ties a string to its top and leans back to pull.

lines.text: Sam. If you pull it... you'll pull it *out*.
lines.tts: [quiet, firm] Sam. If you pull it... you'll pull it out.
lines.note: She stops knitting for the first time.
Beat: he looks at the little tree, then unties the string gently. The sky starts turning gold.

lines.text: It's getting late. Go home, Sam. Get some sleep.
lines.tts: [warmly] It's getting late. Go home, Sam. Get some sleep.
lines.note: Sunset. Long shadows. Her scarf is now very long; she packs it.

lines.text: Sleep is for people who already *have* trees.
lines.tts: [stubborn] Sleep is for people who already have trees.
[narrowing his eyes, whisper] I'm watching you.
lines.note: Two-finger 'I'm watching you' gesture at the tree. Dissolve to night.

beats: l5 gap: 'One hour later...' card, then they huddle over the phone.
l10 gap: the mirror rule of three (up: frozen / down: grows) x3.
HOLD: Sam alone at sunset doing the 'I'm watching you' gesture, then a slow dissolve to dusk.
